services.name: Noon Cruise
services.desc: Set sail on a serene daytime adventure aboard our custom 35' pontoon catamaran and immerse yourself in the beauty of Marco Island's waterways. Departing from Rose Marina, Dock A, Slip 17. Cruise through the peaceful waters of the Marco River and beyond, taking in the stunning scenery of Marco Island’s bays, waterways, and coastal surroundings. Keep your eyes open for playful dolphins, graceful manatees, and vibrant tropical birds as you explore the island from the water. Our knowledgeable crew will share fascinating stories about Marco Island’s history, highlight notable landmarks, and point out celebrity residences along the route.
